steps.name: Given: a scarcity notice has started a 14-day choose clock and 30-day notice clock for a household with two holdings
When: the household chooses one holding before the choose deadline
Then: that holding is identified for loss at the notice deadline; the household keeps using it until the notice deadline; its other holding is not identified for loss
